title: GM Cockpit, Instant Prep, Scene Recipes & Preview-as-Player
objective: Deliver the low-friction GM preparation cockpit and preview-as-player workflow—drag/drop or import through recognize, calibrate/confirm and Make Playable; semantic placement and scene/audio controls; entitlement-aware provider resolution; and shareable Scene Recipes containing semantic preparation, mappings, provider references and fallback intent without redistributing third-party commercial media—while preserving canonical Scene/owner state, MAI/AAI authority, permissions and completed ISE-01..06 boundaries.

persistence.reason: The bounded ISE-07 slice composes existing Scene/owner/MAI/AAI/permission/entitlement references into local preparation plans, filtered player previews and portable recipe projections. It creates no new canonical owner record or durable preparation ledger.

preserved_boundaries: ISE-01..06 remain completed_verified with no reopened implementation authority.
Scene semantic preparation, owner-domain objects, MAI assets/geometry, AAI audio/provider state, permissions and entitlement-access remain canonical; ISE-07 composes workflows and proposals only.

Preview-as-player consumes an already permission-filtered projection and cannot expose hidden/GM-only inventory, metadata, notes, counts, unrevealed regions, protected cardinality or provider secrets.
Generated geometry, room classification, placements, cue selections and other smart suggestions remain assistance until confirmed where certainty is insufficient.
Make Playable produces deterministic preparation intent and governed owner-operation proposals; it does not silently mutate canonical Scene or owner state.

Scene Recipes may contain semantic preparation, mappings, provider references and fallback intent but cannot include commercial third-party media bytes, credentials, hidden state or entitlement claims.
AAI capability/entitlement evidence is consumed as evidence only; ISE-07 cannot infer rights, call providers, store credentials or acquire content bytes.
Missing assets, silence, placeholders and theater-of-the-mind remain valid nonblocking operation.
Migration 0022 remains unreserved; ISE-08 multiplayer/accessibility/performance golden proof remains unauthorized.
No paid provider activation, unauthorized media redistribution, tester distribution, release or deployment is authorized.
next_action: Validate and merge this exact ISE-07 governed-start AIOC candidate. Only after Repository Health passes may the registered application branch be created at 1e957436bdc479d2a292866ea5032962ee0ba2bc and product source mutate.
